description.value: Crag X is a downtown Victoria indoor climbing gym founded in 1995 by outdoor climbers, housed in its own building with 15m-high walls, a dramatic glass street-front facade, and two bouldering areas. Its state-of-the-art ventilation system fully replaces the air every 2–3 hours, making it, as the gym puts it, 'the closest thing to outside you can fit in a building.' Beyond day passes, it offers beginner lessons, a transition-to-outdoors program, and a community-focused ethos welcoming all ages and abilities.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: stands (38 spaces) at 11m; staple (6 spaces) at 49m; wide_stands (16 spaces) at 75m; rack (10 spaces) at 96m. Total: 70 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website's /hours-location-contact page explicitly states 'We have lots of bike parking right outside our front doors,' confirming bike parking. The address (769 Pandora Avenue, Victoria, BC V8W1N9) and phone (250-383-4628) are both corroborated by the website. No mention of washrooms, showers, water refill, or most other amenities appears in the website content, so those fields remain null.
concerns: OSM phone field is empty; phone number 250-383-4628 sourced from website only — contact_confirmed.phone set to null.
Website address (V8W1N9 postal code) is more complete than OSM address; used website value.
OSM opening_hours differ slightly from website hours (e.g. OSM shows closes at 23:00 weekdays; website shows 10pm/11pm); OSM tags may be outdated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established downtown Victoria attraction that explicitly accommodates cyclists with 'lots of bike parking right outside our front doors' and easy bus access; a useful stop for touring cyclists wanting a unique indoor activity.
enrichment_extras.notes: Website also lists email desk@cragx.ca, not present in OSM tags.

wow_evidence: Established (1995) downtown climbing gym with day passes — genuine rest-day activity.
blurb: Downtown climbing gym with 15 m walls; day passes for visitors.
